plan.title: Move every dashboard dialog onto the shared Modal primitive
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: One repo-wide grep acceptance check over ~44 dialogs. All migrations depend on a single Modal API foundation item, are mechanically identical and file-disjoint (only fork-modal and feature-metadata-modals share command-deck.module.css, serialized by an edge), so they fan out in parallel under one plan; splitting into sibling issues would duplicate the foundation dependency and the final audit.

narratives.Problem: About 44 dashboard dialogs draw bespoke backdrops and panels (bg-card/bg-popover, which under Broadsheet light are darker than the page, mostly without shadow), so they look sunken and inconsistent, and each re-implements or lacks Escape, scrim dismissal and focus handling.
narratives.Proposal: Extend the PAN-4755 Modal primitive once (sizes, alertdialog, preserved accessible names, header actions, caller key handler, headless mode, warning tone, nested-modal isolation), add a shared ModalForm field stylesheet, then migrate each centered modal dialog onto Modal in parallel file-disjoint items, delete four unimported modal components, document the rule in STYLE-GUIDE.md and verify with an exact grep allowlist plus test-role UAT screenshots.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing any dialog's copy, fields, validation, endpoints or flow
- Restyling dialog content other than form controls and footer buttons (markdown, tables, task lists, diffs, QR codes)
- De-duplicating anywhereDialog.module.css, editDialog.module.css or the New conversation field rules into ModalForm.module.css
- Migrating popovers, menus, tooltips, command palettes (CommandPalette, SearchModal, QuickOpen), side drawers (IssueDrawer, AgentDetailView, ContainerDetailPanel, LeftColumn drawer), MobileChrome phone sheet, ImageLightbox, XBriefFullscreen, IsolationMode, PlanDialog, EmergencyStopOverlay, the God View help overlay or recovery.tsx
- Deleting AgentDetailView, ContainerDetailPanel or the BadgeBar/FeatureMetadata chain
- A committed Playwright e2e spec
- A z-index prop, stacking layers or an icon slot on Modal
- Any migration item editing Modal.tsx or Modal.module.css (only modal-api does)

autoDecisions.summary: Set plan.metadata.sizeJustification instead of splitting into sibling issues.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's acceptance check is a single repo-wide grep and every migration depends on one Modal API change; the 38 migration items are mechanically identical, file-disjoint and run in parallel under one foundation, so sibling issues would only add coordination around a shared primitive.

autoDecisions.summary: Extend Modal with size, alert, ariaLabel, closeLabel, headerActions, onKeyDown, headless/labelledBy, describedBy and tone in one foundation item (PRD D1).
autoDecisions.rationale: Each prop is required by a concrete dialog (DialogProvider alertdialog, preserved test names, Fork help button, decision dialog keys and header, Add project steps); concentrating them keeps migration items from editing the primitive in parallel.

autoDecisions.summary: Preserve every dialog's current accessible name and close-button name (D4).
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue allows test changes only where names or structure changed; preserving names keeps unit tests and Playwright specs outside the CI list stable.

autoDecisions.summary: Map Escape and scrim click to each dialog's existing dismiss action, guarded by its existing condition; ChannelPermissionDialog is non-dismissible (D5).
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue says every dialog gets Escape/scrim dismissal, and also says to keep behavior; mapping to the existing dismiss path satisfies both without inventing new outcomes such as an implicit Deny.

autoDecisions.summary: Create components/shared/ModalForm.module.css as the shared field styles; leave anywhereDialog/editDialog modules as they are (D9).
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-4755 left no shared field module, only per-area copies; a new shared file gives migrated dialogs one source without touching 20 already-migrated dialogs.

autoDecisions.summary: Delete DeepWipeDialog, SwitchModelModal, ProviderEnvOverrideDialog and GodView/FocusView instead of migrating them (D10).
autoDecisions.rationale: Nothing imports them, so a migration cannot be verified, and leaving them fails the grep acceptance check.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep command palettes, PlanDialog, side drawers, phone sheets and recovery.tsx out of scope (D11).
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's scope rule covers only clearly centered modals; palettes are top-anchored without a header, PlanDialog is a draggable resizable window that minimizes on scrim click, drawers are side panels.

autoDecisions.summary: Run the five-dialog screenshots as a work item (uat-five-dialogs) that commits ten PNGs, repeated by the test role in UAT; no committed e2e spec (D12).
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-4755 closed its browser checks the same way (its uat-browser-checks item was completed by the work agent), and a pending UAT-only criterion on a migration item would block pan done.

autoDecisions.summary: Run DialogProvider and ActionDialogFrame in parallel with the other migrations, at high priority, instead of strictly first (D16).
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks to migrate the shared frames first, but they share no files with other dialogs; priority keeps them first for a sequential executor without adding false blocking edges.

autoDecisions.summary: Drop decorative header icons and keep a single Modal z-index (D7, D13).
autoDecisions.rationale: Modal's header design from PAN-4755 has no icon slot, and portal mount order already stacks a dialog opened from another dialog on top.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1. Add ModalProps size ('narrow'|'default'|'wide'|'xl', replacing wide), alert, ariaLabel, closeLabel, headerActions, onKeyDown, headless + labelledBy, describedBy, tone ('default'|'warning'). Behavior: capture the opener with useState at first render; keep focus if it is already inside the panel; ignore keydown whose target is outside the panel DOM; run props.onKeyDown first and skip own handling when defaultPrevented; handled Escape calls stopPropagation; the scrim onClick calls stopPropagation. CSS: .sizeNarrow/.sizeDefault/.sizeWide/.sizeXl max widths 440/600/760/1000 (no class named default), .warning border color-mix(var(--warning) 40%), .headerActions, .headlessBody (flex column, padding 0, no border-top, still the scroll container); remove max-width from .panel. HomeHeader.tsx: wide -> size="wide". Add the twelve Modal.test.tsx tests named in the PRD.
